{{Top|leg}}
An '''entomology database''' catalogued common pests. The database, coupled with [[Life-form scanner/Legends|lifeform scanners]], allowed [[pest-control droid]]s like the [[TS-Arach series Pest Control Droid]] to identify creatures that potentially threatened the crops they were assigned to patrol.
